transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having trouble keeping my head clear, especially at work. I’ll lose track of what clients are saying, or read the same note over and over. Then I get stuck on simple decisions I used to just handle.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?
I don’t know… maybe a bit. I haven’t really been thinking of it that way.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
I’m not sure. I mean… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed being on edge in a clear way.
Do you feel like you've been feeling sad most of the day?
I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed it as sadness most of the day… it’s just kind of hard to tell.
Have you had little interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really been picking up my guitar, and I keep skipping soccer and the shelter. Even when I try to cook or go hiking, it just feels kind of… empty, like I’m just doing it because I’m supposed to.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight lately?
Yeah… a little, I think. My pants feel looser. I haven’t really been eating much unless someone kind of reminds me.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Maybe about a month. It kind of started after the clinic lost some staff and my schedule shifted later… with more crisis paperwork and stuff.
Have you been feeling worthless or guilty about things?
Yeah… I mean, I guess. If I miss one thing in a note or don’t call someone back right away, I kind of… tell myself I’m useless. Like I’m letting the clients down, and everyone at the clinic too.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly or feeling like it's harder to get things done physically?
Yeah… kind of. Even little things feel harder than they should. Like showering, driving in, getting through paperwork… it feels like I’m dragging around a backpack full of bricks.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide?
I… yeah, kind of. I don’t have a plan to hurt myself or anything, but I keep having thoughts like… maybe it’d be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And that scares me.
Have you been experiencing these feelings of sadness and emptiness nearly every day?
I don’t know… most days, I guess. It’s kind of just there.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you usually find pleasurable?

Yeah… I think so. My guitar’s just been sitting in the corner, and I keep bailing on soccer and the shelter. Even stuff I try to do, like cooking or hiking, just feels like I’m going through the motions. Like there’s no point to it.
Have you been feeling sad or empty for most of the day, every day?
I’m not really sure. It’s… a lot of the day, I guess, but I don’t know if it’s every day.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

Not really… I mean, I try sometimes. Cooking, hiking, stuff like that. But it just feels kind of empty, like I’m only doing it because I’m supposed to. My guitar’s been sitting there, and I keep skipping soccer and the shelter. So… no, not much.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight, like more than 5% of your body weight, in the past month?

I don’t know the exact amount. I haven’t really been weighing myself. But… my pants are looser, and most days I don’t feel hungry unless someone reminds me to eat. I guess I’ve been skipping meals without meaning to.
Have you had at least two weeks where you felt either depressed or lost interest in things most of the day?

Yeah… I think so. It’s been about a month, maybe. Since the clinic lost some staff and my schedule got pushed into late evenings, with more crisis paperwork… it’s just kind of been like this most days.
Do you feel like your depression is mild, or is it interfering more significantly with your daily life?

It’s… more than mild, I think. I told my supervisor I needed help because I was making mistakes and hesitating, and it was starting to affect client care. I didn’t really trust myself to keep working safely without getting evaluated.
